messages.subject: secr 4.5.8
parts:
secr 4.5.8 is on CRAN. New functions (chat.nk, adjustVarD) calculate Fletcher's c-hat and use it to adjust the confidence limits of density estimates for spatial overdispersion*. Several minor bugs are fixed. See here for details.

* These functions are a bit experimental and do not cover all cases.
